Sovereign Climate Finance in Africa: Converting National Plans into Investable, Accountable Infrastructure Pipelines

The Africa Sovereign Climate Facility creates a new route from national climate plans to sovereign infrastructure finance. Its value will be determined less by the amount announced than by whether four governments can select projects with material climate value, prepare them to investment standard, carry the resulting obligations transparently and measure services that communities and businesses actually receive.
